verdict.rationale: Weaviate's own docs describe importing data and many objects into a collection, with automatic vectorization or pre-computed vectors. That is a bulk write path, but the evidence never names a batch API or bulk update/delete operations. missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API documentation, bulk update and bulk delete across many items, performance or limits details, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Create a collection and import data into it.
Import objects directly into Weaviate without having to manually specify embeddings
automatic vectorization at import using integrated models ... or direct import of pre-computed vector embeddings
